test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"Jump through hoops"
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e., To go through many difficulties.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"Jump through hoops"** means to go through many challenges or difficulties, often to meet someone's demands or expectations. (कठिनाइयों का सामना करना) • **Example:** She had to jump through hoops to get approval for her visa application. • The correct meaning is related to the effort or struggle required to achieve something difficult. (कठिन कार्य को पूरा करने में संघर्ष) • **Example:** The team jumped through hoops to meet the tight deadline for the project. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e., To go through many difficulties.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To be very happy** (बहुत खुश होना): Refers to a state of joy or excitement. • **Example:** He was very happy when he won the lottery. • **Option 3: To perform tricks** (चालें करना): Refers to doing clever or deceptive actions, often for entertainment. • **Example:** The magician performed tricks that amazed the audience. • **Option 4: To escape quickly** (जल्दी भाग जाना): Refers to fleeing or running away from a situation rapidly. • **Example:** The thief escaped quickly before the police arrived. f0:Tf36, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 1 अर्थात, कई कठिनाइयों से गुजरना।**
